title: Acknowledgements
text: Acknowledgements This book was passed through so many talented, loving hands on its way to completion, and I am immensely grateful to everyone who lent me their time, encouragement, and expertise in the writing process. Thank you to all my wonderful critique partners and beta readers who helped make this book into what it is today. Thank you to my fantastic agent Tara for encouraging me every step of the way, and my great love Kit for supporting me and being my sounding board. Finally, thank you to my editor, Celine, who helped me build this project from the ground up and bring it to life.
